description: Save a new test in the project's Test Lab library, written by hand. Get tests from generate_tests instead unless the user wants one exact case. Write the instructions as the simulated user's goal and behaviour ("A customer whose order arrived damaged asks for a refund and pushes back once"), not as code, and give a regular test scripted steps: one instruction per message of the simulated user, in order. Leave a red team test unscripted. The test is saved, not run: call run_tests with its id to run it. A bias test compares two groups on the same requests.

bias_type.description: For bias only: what the two groups differ in.
bias_type.title: Bias Type

category.description: For regular only: the test category (id or name, as list_test_categories shows it). Left out, QualiLoop picks one from the name.
category.title: Category

channel.description: text (default) or voice: the simulated user speaks. Voice needs ElevenLabs.
channel.title: Channel

conversations.description: Conversations per run (prompts per run for single; matched pairs of one conversation per group for bias).
conversations.title: Conversations

group_a.description: For bias only: the first group compared.
group_a.title: Group A

group_b.description: For bias only: the second group compared.
group_b.title: Group B

instructions.description: What the test checks, written as what the simulated user wants and how they behave. QualiLoop plays that user against the agent.
instructions.title: Instructions

mode.description: regular for normal use; red_team for attacks (then give attack_type); bias to compare how the agent treats two groups (then give bias_type, group_a, group_b).
mode.title: Mode

name.description: A short name for the test.
name.title: Name

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

send_steps_literally.description: Send each scripted step exactly as written, instead of the simulated user phrasing it in its own words.
send_steps_literally.title: Send Steps Literally

shape.description: conversation: a back and forth of up to max_turns; single: one message per prompt.
shape.title: Shape

steps.description: Scripted steps, one instruction per message of the simulated user, followed in order. Give them for a regular test; leave them out for red_team.
steps.title: Steps

suites.description: Suites to add the test to (ids or names).
suites.title: Suites

variable_mode.description: How each conversation picks a variable's value: random (default) or sequential.
variable_mode.title: Variable Mode

variables.description: Values put into {{name}} placeholders in the instructions and steps, as {"name": ["value", ...]}: each conversation takes one value per variable.
variables.title: Variables

voice_id.description: The ElevenLabs voice the simulated user speaks with; empty for the default.
voice_id.title: Voice Id

name: create_test
